written: 2026-11-12, committed before any gate of PR 259's fix round ran (the commit that adds this file is the timestamp): the fix round's gates for the penalty rung (Drag.Penalty): the part's place and the window (M1), the solid a cell off its pose (M3), the share's couple (M4), the FVM naming no scheme (M2); B1's refusal, the run-time guard, M5 and M6 are added as amendments before they run
labels: the fix round's builder (Opus); from the refuting review's measurements, the code read, and one scratch measurement named under seen_before
seen_before: scratch, this builder, float64, laptop: the lifted indicator's centroid about the solid's place in a free 32^3 box, a sphere of 3 cells a radius at three parts' places (centred, 2 radii along x, (0, 1.3, 0.7) radii) and three drawn poses each: clean at most 0.0030 cells; with the solid a cell off its pose on every axis, 0.997 to 1.002 cells
the refuting review: gate 3b's held sphere reads its net load 3.7 % of rho V g; FVM() with no scheme refused as entry.defect (KeyError 'viscosity')

operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: F1: a free periodic box of 32^3 cells, h = 10 um, a sphere of 3 cells a radius; F2: gate 3b's held sphere (a/R 0.375, 6 cells a radius, the steady Stokes step) with its part a quarter radius along the axis; F3: R3's case (N = 3, dt 1.5e-4 s) with no scheme written
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: F1: one pose a run from DETECTION_SEED (a sub-cell position in [-1, 1] cells about the box's centre, a uniformly random turn); the others deterministic

gate_F1_part_place.claim: The lifted solid sits at the pose's position plus its turn of the part's place, on every face set, to 0.05 cells

prediction.why: a sphere's indicator is symmetric about its centre; the band's smooth ramp makes the discrete centroid's error a quadrature error, 0.003 cells measured in float64; float32's rounding adds about 1e-7 of the box's side

gate_F1_part_place.metric: the indicator's centroid off the expected place, read from the grid's fields (so a lift placed on the wrong faces shows)

control.plant: the solid a cell off its pose on every axis (MIME_PLANT_POSE_CELL): about 1 cell, 20 times the line
control.resolution: the line, 0.05 cells: a shift of a twentieth of a cell

gate_F1_part_place.if_wrong: a centroid off by the part's offset is M1 (the shape's centre overwriting the part's); off on the offset arms only by a few cells, the window clipping the solid
gate_F1_part_place.cannot_discriminate_if: the centroid were read from the window's offsets rather than the grid (self-consistent under the plant)

gate_F2_share_couple.claim: A neutral sphere held off its centre of mass in a closed tube under a drive across the axis takes no net couple: the field's push's couple and the share's, given at the hull's centroid, cancel
gate_F2_share_couple.operating_point: both dtypes; steady Stokes; lever a quarter radius

prediction.unit: the net couple over lever x rho V g
prediction.why: the field's push acts on the hull, so its couple is the lever times the push, which gate 3b measured within 3.7 % of rho V g; the share's couple the lever times rho V g

control.plant: the share given at the centre of mass (MIME_PLANT_SHARE_AT_COM): the net couple the field's alone, about 1

gate_F2_share_couple.if_wrong: a couple near 1 means the solid is not at the hull's place (M1) or the share is at the centre
gate_F2_share_couple.cannot_discriminate_if: the hull is centred (no lever): the review's oracle could not discriminate for that reason

gate_F3_no_scheme.claim: FVM() and FVM(stokes=True) naming no scheme are judged at the scheme the FVM chooses: at R3's step RK3, refused as drag.penalty-scheme, not entry.defect

prediction.why: nu dt/h^2 = 0.038 at R3's step, under RK3's 0.15, so chosen_scheme gives RK3

control.plant: none: the review's run is the control (entry.defect before the fix)

gate_F3_no_scheme.if_wrong: entry.defect means a value the plan does not read is still read

amendment_1: 2026-11-12, committed before the gates below ran: the moving start (the review's m7), the run-time guard on a body's motion (B1), and the near-wall step flag (M6)

gate_F4_moving_start.claim: A neutral body moving at U with a fluid already moving at U keeps its speed over the first step: the interior's momentum change at a run's first step is taken from the start's field
gate_F4_moving_start.operating_point: both dtypes; a free 24^3 box, h 10 um, a sphere of 3 cells a radius, U = 1 mm/s, nu dt/h^2 = 0.1, IMEX Euler without convection

prediction.unit: the first step's velocity change over U
prediction.basis: measured-before (the refuting review: 5e-17 clean, 1.06 planted, float64)
prediction.why: the field and the body move together, so the penalty's load and the interior's change are both zero to the solve's tolerance

control.plant: the interior's momentum at the first step taken as zero (MIME_PLANT_START_AT_REST): a kick of about U

gate_F4_moving_start.if_wrong: a kick means the first step's change is taken from rest
gate_F4_moving_start.cannot_discriminate_if: the fluid starts at rest (every other gate's start)

gate_G_motion_guard.claim: A lagged run past its stable step is stopped by the body's own motion (more than a cell a step) with drag.penalty-motion, naming the body and its coupling, not left to finish at 1e7 m/s
gate_G_motion_guard.operating_point: float64 (the dtype that ran unstopped); the refuting review's Stokes case: R3's tube, N = 3, IMEX Euler with stokes=True, Re 0.1's drive, density ratio 1.0, a uniform sphere's inertia, dt 7e-3 s (x_T 2.9, x_R 3.0); the build's lagged refusal set aside so the run reaches the guard

prediction.unit: the step the run stops at
prediction.basis: measured-before (scratch, this builder: stopped at step 7)
prediction.why: the body's speed grows each step past the edge; it starts near 1e-4 m/s, about 0.01 cells a step, so a growth of about 2 a step crosses the line within ten steps

gate_G_motion_guard.metric: the refusal's code (drag.penalty-motion) and that it names the body and the lagged coupling

control.plant: the guard removed (MIME_PLANT_NO_MOTION_GUARD: the line infinite): the run ends unstopped, as the review measured (6e7 m/s at 100 steps)

gate_G_motion_guard.if_wrong: a stop by another code first (run.non-finite) means the line is too high; no stop means the guard does not see the body's twist
gate_G_motion_guard.cannot_discriminate_if: the run is refused at build (the lagged refusal not set aside)

gate_W_near_wall_flag.claim: A resolved body nearer the tube's wall than 3 cells raises body_<i>_near_wall each step, owned by its drag; a body on the axis raises none
gate_W_near_wall_flag.operating_point: float64; R3's tube at N = 3, Stokes (Re 0.1's drive), a body started 2 cells from the wall, and on the axis (quiet)

prediction.why: the gap is the tube's radius less the body's distance from the axis less its radius, started 2 cells from it: 2 cells; on the axis 5 cells at N = 3 (R 8 cells, a 3)

gate_W_near_wall_flag.metric: the flag water.flow.body_0_near_wall raised or not; body_0_gap

control.plant: none: the quiet case beside it is the control (a body on the axis must not raise it)

gate_W_near_wall_flag.if_wrong: a flag on the axis means the gap is not measured from the axis
gate_W_near_wall_flag.cannot_discriminate_if: both cases raise it, or neither

amendment_2: 2026-11-12, committed before the gate below ran: the interior's momentum change telescopes over a run (the review's m8)

gate_F5_telescoping.claim: The interior's momentum change summed over a run is its momentum at the end less at the start: each step's change taken from the value the step before held, so it telescopes
gate_F5_telescoping.operating_point: both dtypes; gate 3's free 24^3 box, a neutral sphere of 3 cells a radius, g = 50 m/s^2 (the body moves about 1.7 cells in 80 steps), IMEX Euler without convection

prediction.unit: |sum dt (load - penalty) - Q_end| / |Q_end|, the largest component
prediction.basis: measured-before (scratch, this builder: 2.5e-24 in float64, 1.1e-9 in float32)
prediction.why: the sum telescopes exactly; float32's rounding of each step's difference sums to about 1e-9 of the end's momentum

gate_F5_telescoping.metric: the largest component's mismatch over the largest of Q_end

control.plant: the change taken on the step's own indicator (MIME_PLANT_OWN_INDICATOR): measured 1.0e-4 in both dtypes, the indicator's change times the field as the body crosses cells

gate_F5_telescoping.if_wrong: a mismatch means a step's change is not taken from the held value
gate_F5_telescoping.cannot_discriminate_if: the body does not move across cells (the plant's error is the indicator's change)

amendment_3: 2026-11-12, committed before the gates below ran: the penalty rung's Reynolds watch (M6) and the density-ratio flag (M6)

gate_R_reynolds_watch.claim: The penalty rung declares a Reynolds line (150 at the default N, the highest particle Re N = 6 was measured at, falling as N squared below it); the post-run watch is computed (the viscosity read, M2) and raised past the line at the run's N, quiet under it
gate_R_reynolds_watch.operating_point: float64; R3's tube at N = 3 (the line 150 x (3/6)^2 = 37.5), stokes=True at Re 0.1's drive, two steps of 1.5e-4 s; the body started at 0.2 m/s (Re 75 by its diameter) and at rest

prediction.why: the body keeps most of 0.2 m/s over two steps (tau_t 2.4 ms), its Re about 70 past 37.5; at rest about 0.002 under it

control.plant: none: the quiet case beside it is the control

gate_R_reynolds_watch.if_wrong: 'not_computed' means the viscosity is still not read; an upper of 150 at N = 3 means the line does not move with N

gate_D_ratio_flag.claim: A body whose density ratio lies outside the range the lagged coupling's edge was measured over raises its drag's flag (body_<i>_ratio_unmeasured) every step; one inside raises none
gate_D_ratio_flag.operating_point: float64; R3's tube at N = 3, stokes=True at Re 0.1's drive, three steps of 1.5e-5 s; ratios 25 (past the measured 20) and 1

prediction.why: the node reads the body's mass from its mass matrix and the hull's volume

gate_D_ratio_flag.metric: the flag water.flow.body_0_ratio_unmeasured raised or not; body_0_ratio

control.plant: none: the quiet case beside it is the control

gate_D_ratio_flag.if_wrong: a flag at ratio 1 means the ratio is not the mass over rho V

amendment_4: 2026-11-12, committed before the gates below ran: gate 2 re-measured at the default N = 6 with its metric changed, gate 2b (B1's lagged edge at rest at the refusal's line) and B1's refusal

gate_2_at_n6.claim: Gate 2 re-measured at the default N = 6: R3's case at Re 76 (dt 7.5e-5 s), ratios 0.3 and 1.4, runs 200 steps unstopped, finite, the body under twice the flow's largest speed. Its metric changed: the old one (four alternating changes in a row) read a decaying start-up ring as unstable at ratio 0.3, and no growth metric of the body's velocity discriminates in a run driven at Re 76, so stability is judged at rest (gate 2b)
gate_2_at_n6.operating_point: both dtypes; N = 6, IMEX Euler, Re 76, dt 7.5e-5 s

prediction.basis: measured-before (the second edge probe's gate 2 arms, run 43136806547: 200 steps unstopped at N = 6, both ratios, both dtypes; the old metric's longest alternating run 5 at ratio 0.3)
prediction.why: dt/tau_t 0.10 and 0.02, well inside the edges measured at rest

gate_2_at_n6.metric: the run's completion (no stop), finiteness and max|V| < 2 max|u|

control.plant: the body's load reversed (MIME_PLANT_LOAD_SIGN): the body runs away and is stopped or exceeds the bound
control.resolution: n/a: a stop or a bound

gate_2_at_n6.if_wrong: a stop at N = 6 inside the measured edges means the edge moves with Re
gate_2_at_n6.cannot_discriminate_if: a slow growth too slow to reach a stop in 200 steps: that is gate 2b's to see, at rest

gate_2b_lagged_edge_at_rest.claim: At the largest step the lagged refusal admits (its margin's share of the edge measured at N = 6, the binding mode's), R3's uniform sphere at a density ratio of 0.3 at rest decays: its kinetic energy over the last quarter is under its start's
gate_2b_lagged_edge_at_rest.operating_point: both dtypes; N = 6, IMEX Euler, quiescent, 160 steps

prediction.basis: measured-before (the third edge probe's brackets: E/E0 1e-8 to 1e-3 at the stable end at N = 3)
prediction.why: at 0.8 of the stable end every mode decays

gate_2b_lagged_edge_at_rest.metric: max E over the last quarter / E(0)

control.plant: the step a quarter past the measured edge (MIME_PLANT_PAST_EDGE; the refusal set aside): the energy grows past its start's or the motion guard stops the run

gate_2b_lagged_edge_at_rest.if_wrong: growth at the admitted step means the margin is too thin or the binding mode is not the one measured
gate_2b_lagged_edge_at_rest.cannot_discriminate_if: the plant's step is refused at build (the refusal not set aside)

gate_B1_refusal.claim: A step past the lagged coupling's measured edge is refused at build (drag.penalty-lagged), naming the largest step the edges admit and the affine coupling; a body lighter than the least measured ratio is refused
gate_B1_refusal.operating_point: float64; the refuting review's Stokes case (R3, N 3, dt 7e-3 s, ratio 1) and R3 at ratio 0.2

prediction.why: x_T 2.9 and x_R 3.0 against edges near 0.85 and 0.9 at N 3 ratio 1 with the fluid's inertia stored

gate_B1_refusal.metric: the code and its action's text

control.plant: none: gate 2b's clean arm is the refusal's inside, this its outside

gate_B1_refusal.if_wrong: no refusal means the table does not reach this point

amendment_6: 2026-11-12, committed before the gate below ran (the coordinator's question from the near-wall spike: a float32 steady drive solve of a held sphere stagnated at 1.7e-3 against 1e-5, read by hand)

gate_S_solve_flag.claim: A resolved body's flow whose solve stops above its tolerance (stagnated or capped) raises solve_flagged in its step's state and, in a run, the FVM's warned flag with its count; the same run at the default tolerance raises neither
gate_S_solve_flag.operating_point: both dtypes; R3's tube at N = 3, the steady scheme (stokes=True), Re 0.1's drive, three steps of 1.5e-4 s; the tolerance planted at 1e-30, below either dtype's rounding

prediction.unit: flag raised at 3 of 3 steps and one warning; none at the default
prediction.why: ResolvedFlowNode takes its parent's step, whose report sets solve_flagged where the CG stops other than converging, and the FVM declares the flag warns=True (tests/flow/test_fvm_experiment.py holds it for the plain node)

gate_S_solve_flag.metric: result.flags' water.flow.solve_flagged (raised, steps), the UserWarning naming it, the last report's stop counts

control.plant: the planted tolerance itself; the default tolerance is the quiet case beside it

gate_S_solve_flag.if_wrong: a quiet flag at 1e-30 means the resolved node's step drops its parent's report
gate_S_solve_flag.cannot_discriminate_if: both cases raise it (the default would then stagnate too)
